stories.title: Passkey Sign-In Gate, Step-Up Re-Verification & Owner Guard
stories.description: Re-groomed 2026-09-25 (split from the original 8-point hardening story; session management, alerts and browser hardening moved to STORY-118). Passkeys are optional, but once a user has one it is required at every sign-in, so a stolen Discord account alone cannot reach the dashboard. Removing a passkey needs a fresh passkey check. Sensitive writes (owner console, integrations, moderation escalation policy, reaction-role publishing) always need a passkey check newer than 5 minutes, so users without a passkey cannot perform them. Bot owners (BOT_OWNER_ID) must have a passkey. Recovery is an operator CLI reset, not recovery codes. Sessions stay opaque and server-side: JWE was re-evaluated and rejected again because a stolen token is replayed, not decrypted (ADR-013).

stories.title: Session Management, Sign-In & Change Alerts, Browser Hardening & Authorization Coverage
stories.description: Split from STORY-117 on 2026-09-25. Makes a stolen session visible and killable (active sessions page, new-device and passkey-removal DMs, dashboard change notices in the guild log channel) and hardens the browser side (nonce CSP, security headers, React taint, rate limits) with a test that fails if any Server Action or route handler skips its guard. Risk-based re-checks on IP or user-agent changes were considered and dropped: an infostealer copies the device cookie together with the session cookie, and IP binding misfires for mobile and VPN users.

stories.title: Chrome Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) for Dashboard Sessions
stories.description: Optional enhancement from ADR-013 decision 4, parked 2026-09-25. Where the browser supports DBSC, bind the dashboard session to a TPM-held key and issue short-lived cookies that must be refreshed with a signature, so a cookie copied by malware stops working within minutes. Estimate is provisional: confirm current browser and platform support before grooming.

stories.title: Unified Configurable Reset Boundary & Consecutive-Miss Streak Forgiveness
stories.description: Replace the five independent UTC calendar-day resets with one shared configurable reset boundary (default 00:00 GMT+8), exposed through a core ResetSchedule helper returning an integer day index. Covers energy replenishment, the energy potion daily ceiling, TCG shop daily rotation, the economy shop daily purchase limit and /daily. Converts /daily from a rolling 24h cooldown with 12h grace into a calendar-day claim with consecutive-miss streak forgiveness: fewer consecutive missed days than the configured threshold preserve the streak (missed days are skipped, never counted), reaching the threshold wipes the streak and the triggering claim counts as day 1. Missed count is derived from lastDailyAt rather than persisted. One global timezone offset with per-feature clock-time overrides.

tasks.title: WebAuthn Passkeys: web_passkeys Table, Security Page (Add/Remove), Sign-In Gate for Enrolled Users & requireStepUp
tasks.description: Dual-dialect web_passkeys table (credential ID, public key, signature counter, transports, device type and backed-up flags, user-given name, created and last-used times) and @simplewebauthn/server + @simplewebauthn/browser (recorded in dependency-evaluation.md). rpID and origin come from DASHBOARD_URL; user verification required; attestation none. Challenges travel in a short-lived vault-sealed __Host- cookie bound to the session. Security page lists passkeys (synced or this device only) and adds or removes them; removal needs a passkey check within 5 minutes. Sign-in gate: while a user has at least one passkey, a session without a passkey check is redirected to a verify page before any other page or Server Action. A passkey check sets step_up_at and rotates the session ID (re-encrypting the Discord tokens under the new ID). requireStepUp() returns a step-up-required result that the client form resolves with a passkey prompt and retries. Passkey add/remove are written to audit_logs. Tests: registration and assertion verification, counter regression, sign-in gate, step-up window, session rotation.

The bot permission middleware is not wired today and no command is owner-only, so the bot is left unchanged. ririko passkeys:reset <user_id> deletes a user's passkeys and ends their sessions, audited with a cli actor, as the recovery path for lost authenticators. Tests for the guard and the CLI.

tasks.description: List the user's web_sessions (created, last seen, IP, user agent, current session marked) with per-session revoke and sign out everywhere. A long-lived random __Host- device cookie, stored hashed in a dual-dialect web_known_devices table, marks known browsers; a sign-in from an unknown one, and any passkey removal, sends the user a Discord DM through bot-token REST (best effort: users who block DMs are skipped). tasks.title: Strict Nonce CSP & Security Headers, React Taint & server-only Secret Guards, Server Action Authorization Coverage Test
tasks.description: Nonce-based CSP without unsafe-inline, frame-ancestors none, HSTS, nosniff, strict Referrer-Policy and COOP, set in proxy.ts, which only sets headers and never authorizes (CVE-2025-29927). A test parses every use-server export and route handler and fails if one does not go through saveGuildSettings, requireGuildAccess, requireStepUp or requireOwner, apart from an explicit allowlist of auth routes.

bugs.title: Daily Energy Replenishment Never Fires: EnergyLifecycleService Is Unwired
bugs.description: EnergyLifecycleService.getOrReconcileUserEnergy and replenishUserEnergy had no callers anywhere in apps/ or packages/, so player energy was never replenished and max energy never scaled with player level. Players spent their starting 100 energy and could never recover it except through the 3/day potion ceiling. Fixed by making EnergyLifecycleService the gateway for every energy debit (spendEnergy, consumePotion, refundEnergy), wiring it into expeditions, dungeon runs, boss raids, PvP duels and both potion paths, and giving it an XP-backed level resolver so capacity scales without callers passing a level. Note: the half-energy refund on dungeon floors 1-10 was already implemented in DungeonProgressService and correctly wired; the original report was wrong on that point.

bugs.title: Catalog Seed Is Insert-Only, So Item Copy and Stat Changes Never Reach Existing DBs
